message.content: Proposed 2 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Unify the English question stems in survey.tex (parallel, complete phrasing) and sync the question numbering (Q1/Q2) plus scale endpoints in methods.tex.

hunks.oldText:
Q1. How satisfied are you?
Options: 1 = Very dissatisfied; 2 = Dissatisfied; 3 = Neutral; 4 = Satisfied; 5 = Very satisfied.
Q2. Would you recommend the service?
Options: 1 = Definitely no; 2 = Probably no; 3 = Unsure; 4 = Probably yes; 5 = Definitely yes.
hunks.newText:
Q1. How satisfied are you with the service?
Options: 1 = Very dissatisfied; 2 = Dissatisfied; 3 = Neutral; 4 = Satisfied; 5 = Very satisfied.
Q2. Would you recommend the service to others?
Options: 1 = Definitely no; 2 = Probably no; 3 = Unsure; 4 = Probably yes; 5 = Definitely yes.

hunks.oldText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: We used a five-level scale, ranging from 1 (Very dissatisfied / Definitely no) to 5 (Very satisfied / Definitely yes), and analyzed Q1 and Q2.
